run_evaluate_policy_cli: run the evaluate policy script with random goals for all difficulty levels and an output directory
generate_test_set: generate random test samples with initial and goal poses for each difficulty level
run_evaluate_policy_sample: run evaluate_policy.py subprocess with a single TestSample containing difficulty, init pose, goal pose, and logfile
create_test_sample: create a TestSample named tuple with difficulty, iteration, init pose json, goal pose json, and logfile fields
main_evaluate_policy: main entry point that generates test data, pickles samples, and runs evaluate_policy.py for each sample
